isolated_local.description: One node, its own memory only, no coordination. Capability floor.

centralized.description: One hub node holds every premise. Succeeds trivially; holds the answer.

full_replication.description: All four nodes hold both premises; all copies share one root per slot.

fixed_distributed_replication.description: Three replicas of the right premise across three nodes, one shared root.

source_count_repair.description: Same placement; repair prefers the most-replicated support first.

random_path_diversification.description: Independent support exists; repair picks a candidate at random.

lineage_aware_repair.description: Same placement; repair excludes the failed roots and domains.

oracle_min_cut.description: Four records placed for maximum min-cut: both slots doubly rooted.

stale_knowledge.description: The load-bearing memory is present but no longer valid at query time.

network_partition.description: The coordinator is isolated with a minority of nodes.
